content:
This week, Apple refreshed its third-party accessories lineup with eight new products, including the Aqara Thermostat Hub W200.

Aqara first unveiled the Thermostat Hub W200 at CES 2026 in January and officially launched it in April.

The Aqara Thermostat Hub W200 is priced at US$169.95 at Apple Retail. Although it costs US$10 more than on Amazon, the price is reasonable if you have Apple credit to use or are already shopping at Apple.

Apple bringing it into its online and physical stores is a strong endorsement. The product also supports Apple Home-exclusive features such as Apple Adaptive Temperature and Clean Energy Guidance.

Apple also carries the higher-priced ecobee Smart Thermostat Premium, which supports built-in Siri and connects to HomeKit directly rather than via Matter.

However, the Aqara version remains attractive, offering Adaptive Temperature and Clean Energy Guidance support through the Apple Home app.

Apple Store's inventory update this week added another Aqara smart home product: the Aqara Climate Sensor W100.

In addition to the two Aqara smart home products mentioned above, Apple currently also sells the following six accessories:

  • Nimble Powerstack Charger/Power Bank combo
  • Herschel Cloudform 14-inch MacBook Sleeve
  • Herschel Cloudform 16-inch MacBook Sleeve
  • Herschel Cloudform MacBook XL Backpack
  • CalDigit Thunderbolt 5 (USB‑C) Pro Cable (2.0m)
  • Logitech Spotlight 2 Presentation Remote

Up next, people are eagerly awaiting the iPhone Duo launching later this month, and the rumored screen-equipped HomePod expected to debut in October.

Make the most of your Apple products
